description.en: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions, or commit messages.
description.zh: 分层的技术写作标准：Diátaxis 管文档结构，Google 开发者文档风格管句子，STE 管指令写法，Global English 管句法。用于 /technical-writing，或者写、审文档、RFC、README、PR 说明和提交信息的时候。

blocks.en: Write so a tired engineer understands on the first read.
blocks.zh: 写到让一个累了的工程师读第一遍就懂。

blocks.en:
- Cut every word that does no work.
- Use the short, everyday word: "use", not "utilize".
- When a rule makes a sentence worse, fix the sentence another way or leave it alone.
- Write the real symbol, file, flag, or command name, not a synonym or a description of it.
- Don't invent jargon. Use the words a developer would say out loud. Say what a named pattern means the first time.
blocks.zh:
- 删掉每一个不干活的词。
- 用简短的日常词：用「use」，不用「utilize」。
- 一条规则让句子变差时，换个办法改这个句子，或者干脆别动它。
- 写真实的符号名、文件名、参数名或命令名，不写同义词，也不写对它的描述。
- 不要自造行话。用开发者会说出口的词。有名字的模式，第一次出现时说清它是什么意思。

blocks.en:
- Mix sentence lengths. Split the sentence that carries two thoughts. Keep the long sentence that carries one.
- Have a view in explanation. Keep reference dry.
- Be specific. Not "schema changes can cause issues" but "a column rename fails the build".
blocks.zh:
- 混用长短句。一句里装了两个意思，就拆开。一个长句只装一个意思，就留着。
- 讲解类文档要有观点。参考类文档保持干巴巴的。
- 要具体。不写「schema 改动可能引发问题」，写「改一个列名，构建就会失败」。

blocks.en: One document, one mode. Don't mix modes. Split and link instead.
blocks.zh: 一篇文档，一种类型。不要混用类型。拆开，再互相链接。

blocks.en:
- **Tutorial: learning by doing.** Say what the learner will build. Every step produces a visible result, and you say what they should see. Explanation gets one clause and a link.
- **How-to: steps to a goal.** Solve the reader's problem. Assume competence. Action only. Allow forks. Name the guide by the task.
- **Reference: facts for lookup.** Only describe. Be dry, complete, and sure. Mirror the structure of the thing described.
- **Explanation: understanding and why.** One bounded topic. Give context: design decisions, history, constraints, alternatives. Opinion is allowed here and nowhere else.
blocks.zh:
- **教程：边做边学。** 说出学习者会做出什么。每一步都产生看得见的结果，并告诉对方应该看到什么。讲解压缩成一个分句加一个链接。
- **操作指南：通向目标的步骤。** 解决读者的问题。假设读者有能力。只写行动。允许分岔。用任务给指南命名。
- **参考：供查阅的事实。** 只描述。干巴巴、完整、确定。照着被描述对象的结构来组织。
- **讲解：理解和为什么。** 一个有边界的主题。给出背景：设计决策、历史、限制、其他方案。观点只能在这里出现，别处都不行。

blocks.en: ## Write sentences to the reader (Google developer style)
blocks.zh: ## 句子要对着读者写（Google 开发者文档风格）

blocks.en:
- Talk to the reader as "you", in the present tense.
- Say who does what. Passive is fine only when the actor is unknown or beside the point.
- Write instructions as commands. Put the condition before the instruction and the common case first.
- No buzzwords, no figurative language, no "please", and never "simply", "easy", or "quickly" in a procedure.
- Don't pre-announce, and don't start consecutive sentences with the same phrase.
- Link with words that say where the link goes.
- Headings carry the point, in sentence case. One h1 per page, no skipped levels.
- Numbered lists for sequences, bullets for everything else. Introduce a list with a complete sentence. Keep items parallel.
- Code goes in code font. UI elements go in bold. Use serial commas. Drop "etc.".
blocks.zh:
- 用「你」称呼读者，用现在时。
- 说清谁做了什么。只有不知道是谁做的，或者是谁做的无关紧要时，才可以用被动。
- 指令写成命令句。条件放在指令前面，常见情况放前面。
- 不用流行词，不用比喻修辞，不写「请」，步骤里绝不写「只需」「很简单」或「很快」。
- 不要预告，也不要连续几句用同一个短语开头。
- 链接要用能说明它指向哪里的文字。
- 标题要带出要点，用句子式大小写。每页只有一个 h1，标题层级不跳。
- 有先后顺序的用编号列表，其他都用圆点列表。列表前用一个完整的句子引出。各项结构保持一致。
- 代码用代码字体。界面元素用粗体。列举时最后一项前也加逗号（serial comma）。不写「etc.」。

blocks.en: ## Make statements load one at a time (STE rules)
blocks.zh: ## 一次只让读者装进一件事（STE 规则）

blocks.en:
- One instruction per sentence. One thought per sentence everywhere else.
- Split instructions longer than about 20 words and other sentences longer than about 25.
- Put the warning or condition before the step it guards.
- Keep "the" and "a".
- Give each word one meaning, and pick one word per action.
- Write procedures as direct commands, never as narration and never in the passive.
- Avoid "-ing" words where you can.
blocks.zh:
- 一句只写一条指令。其他地方也是一句一个意思。
- 指令超过大约 20 个词就拆开，其他句子超过大约 25 个词就拆开。
- 警告或条件放在它所保护的那一步前面。
- 保留「the」和「a」。
- 每个词只给一个意思，每个动作只选一个词。
- 步骤写成直接的命令，绝不写成叙述，也绝不用被动。
- 能不用「-ing」形式的词，就不用。

blocks.en: ## Leave no sentence open to two readings (Global English)
blocks.zh: ## 每句话都只能有一种读法（Global English）

blocks.en:
- Keep words like "only" and "not" next to the word they change.
- Break up long noun strings.
- Make every "it", "they", and "this" point at one obvious thing. Never use "this" or "which" to point at a whole clause.
- Don't drop verbs, or the small words that show structure, such as "that".
- Repeat the article in a series when it prevents a misread. Say which parts "and" or "or" joins.
- Use periods, not semicolons or em dashes. No slashes, and no "(s)". Make text in parentheses a full grammatical unit.
- Call each thing by one name, everywhere.
- Skip idioms, colloquialisms, Latin abbreviations, and metaphors.
blocks.zh:
- 「only」「not」这类词，要紧挨着它修饰的词。
- 拆开长长的名词串。
- 每个「it」「they」「this」都要指向一个明显的东西。绝不用「this」或「which」指代整个分句。
- 不要省掉动词，也不要省掉表示结构的小词，比如「that」。
- 并列时，重复冠词能避免误读，就重复。说清「and」或「or」连接的是哪几部分。
- 用句号，不用分号或破折号。不用斜杠，也不用「(s)」。括号里的文字要是一个完整的语法单位。
- 每样东西只用一个名字，处处一样。
- 不用习语、口语、拉丁缩写和比喻。
## 口吻和仓库里的具体规矩

blocks.en:
- Apply the **unslop** skill to every doc this skill touches. That skill owns the slop-pattern catalog: AI vocabulary, filler, hedging, formatting tells.
- PR descriptions and commit messages are writing too. Every layer except Diátaxis applies to them. A PR body is a briefing that a reviewer can read in under a minute. Do not paste swarm logs, SHA lists, or metric tables. Link them.
- Product UI strings are not documentation. Use your product's copy guidelines for those.
- Indent code snippets with tabs. Write real paths. Make every count or tree claim true at the commit that lands it, and include the command that regenerates it.
blocks.zh:
- 这个技能碰过的每篇文档，都要过一遍 **unslop** 技能。那个技能管着「AI 腔」模式的清单：AI 爱用的词、凑字数的话、含糊其辞、格式上的破绽。
- PR 说明和提交信息也是写作。除了 Diátaxis，每一层都适用于它们。PR 正文是一份简报，审阅者一分钟内就能读完。不要贴 swarm 日志、SHA 列表或指标表格。给链接。
- 产品界面上的文字不是文档。那些按你们产品的文案规范来写。
- 代码片段用 tab 缩进。写真实的路径。每个关于数量或目录树的说法，在合入它的那次提交上都必须是真的，并附上重新生成它的命令。

lessons.quote: Write so a tired engineer understands on the first read.
lessons.quoteZh: 写到让一个累了的工程师读第一遍就懂。

zh.title: 写给一个具体的读者
zh.does: 写出来的文档不绕弯，读一遍就懂，不用回头再看。
zh.why: 「累了的工程师」「第一遍」是一个能想象的画面，比「写清楚点」好把握得多。
zh.try: 要通知写得好懂，就说：「写到一个刚下夜班的客服读一遍就能照做。」

en.title: Write for one concrete reader
en.does: The doc reads clearly the first time, with no need to go back.
en.why: "A tired engineer" on "the first read" is a picture you can imagine, far easier to aim at than "be clear".
en.try: For a notice people must follow, say: "Write it so a support rep finishing a night shift can act on it after one read."

lessons.quote: Use the short, everyday word: "use", not "utilize".
lessons.quoteZh: 用简短的日常词：用「use」，不用「utilize」。

zh.title: 规则后面跟一个换法
zh.does: 它默认用短的日常词，看到 utilize 这类长词就换成 use。
zh.why: 一条规则配一个具体的「不写这个，写那个」，AI 照着就能换，不用自己猜什么算简单。
zh.try: 想让文字更白，就给一个换法：「写『用』，不写『进行使用』。」

en.title: Follow the rule with one swap
en.does: It uses short everyday words by default and swaps a long word like "utilize" for "use".
en.why: Pairing the rule with one concrete "this, not that" lets the AI copy the swap instead of guessing what counts as simple.
en.try: To get plainer prose, give one swap: "Write 'use', not 'make use of'."

lessons.quote: When a rule makes a sentence worse, fix the sentence another way or leave it alone.
lessons.quoteZh: 一条规则让句子变差时，换个办法改这个句子，或者干脆别动它。

zh.title: 给规则留一个出口
zh.does: 它不会为了守规矩，把句子改得更别扭。
zh.why: 先说清楚规则只是手段、好读才是目的，AI 就不会机械地执行每一条。
zh.try: 列完一串写作要求后，补一句：「哪条要求让句子变难读了，就别照搬，以好读为准。」

en.title: Give the rules a way out
en.does: It won't twist a sentence into something worse just to obey a rule.
en.why: Saying the rules serve readability, not the other way round, stops the AI from applying them mechanically.
en.try: After a list of style rules, add: "If a rule makes a sentence harder to read, skip it. Readability wins."

lessons.quote: Write the real symbol, file, flag, or command name, not a synonym or a description of it.
lessons.quoteZh: 写真实的符号名、文件名、参数名或命令名，不写同义词，也不写对它的描述。

zh.title: 照真实名字写
zh.does: 文档里写的是真实的函数名、文件名和命令，不另起好听的别名。
zh.why: 把「该用什么词」指向代码里现成、能查的名字，AI 就不会自己编叫法。
zh.try: 写使用说明时加一句：「所有按钮名都照 App 界面上的原文写，不要换说法。」

en.title: Use the real names
en.does: The doc uses the real function, file, and command names, not friendlier aliases.
en.why: Pointing "which word to use" at names that already exist in the code stops the AI from inventing its own.
en.try: For a user guide, add: "Write every button name exactly as it appears in the app."

zh.title: 一篇只做一件事
zh.does: 动笔前它先定这篇是教程、操作指南、参考还是讲解，一篇只写一种，别的内容拆出去再放链接。
zh.why: 一条一刀切的规矩加一个处理办法（拆开再链接），AI 不用逐段纠结该不该放进来。
zh.try: 让 AI 写文档时说：「这篇只写安装步骤，原理另写一篇，在这里放链接。」

en.title: One doc, one job
en.does: Before writing, it picks tutorial, how-to, reference, or explanation, writes only that, and splits the rest out behind a link.
en.why: A flat rule plus a fix (split and link) spares the AI from weighing each paragraph on whether it belongs.
en.try: When you ask for a doc, say: "Only the install steps here. Put the background in a separate page and link to it."

compare.without: 步骤里写「只需」「很简单」，还用被动句
compare.with: 步骤写成直接的命令，条件放在命令前面

compare.without: 句子长短都一样，讲解里也没有自己的看法
compare.with: 长短句混着用，讲解类文档写出自己的判断

compare.without: PR 说明里贴一大段日志和 SHA 列表
compare.with: PR 说明写成一分钟读完的简报，日志放链接

zh.intro: 开头先定目标：让累了的工程师读第一遍就懂。再列五条总规矩：删掉不干活的词，用日常词，规则让句子变差就换个改法，写真实的名字，不自造行话。
sections: 长短句故意混用，讲解类文档写出自己的看法，用「改列名会让构建失败」这种具体说法。
一篇只用一种类型：教程每步给出看得见的结果，操作指南只写动作，参考只描述事实，观点只放在讲解里。
对读者用「你」和现在时，指令写成命令，条件放前面，标题写出要点，链接文字说清去哪。
一句一条指令，指令超过约 20 词就拆，警告放在步骤前面，一个动作只用一个词。
「only」「not」紧挨它修饰的词，拆开长名词串，每个「it」只指一样东西，不用分号和斜杠。
改过的文档都再过一遍 `unslop`，PR 和提交信息也照这些规则写，界面文案按产品自己的规范。

compare.without: Writes steps with "simply", "easy" or the passive voice.
compare.with: Writes each step as a direct command, with the condition first.

compare.without: Writes every sentence the same length, with no view even in explanations.
compare.with: Mixes short and long sentences and takes a view in explanations.

compare.without: Pastes logs and SHA lists into the PR body.
compare.with: Writes the PR body as a one-minute briefing and links the logs.

en.intro: It sets the goal, a tired engineer understands on the first read, then five rules: cut idle words, use everyday words, fix a sentence another way when a rule hurts it, write real names, and invent no jargon.
sections: Mixes short and long sentences, takes a view in explanations, and writes specifics like "a column rename fails the build".
One mode per doc: tutorials show a visible result each step, how-tos give only actions, reference only describes, opinion lives in explanations.
Addresses "you" in present tense, writes commands, puts conditions first, makes headings carry the point, and labels links clearly.
One instruction per sentence, a split past about 20 words, warnings before the step, and one word per action.
Keeps "only" and "not" beside their word, breaks up noun strings, gives each "it" one referent, and drops semicolons and slashes.
Runs `unslop` on every touched doc, applies the rules to PRs and commits, and leaves UI strings to product copy guidelines.
